verses.en: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
verses.sm: Isaraelu o le o auo i totonu ia te oe. Amota.

verses.en: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
verses.sm: Faatu ia le tagavai i le mauga tula, ina leo tele ia ia te i latou, ina lui tau atu ia le lima, ia latou ulu atu ai i faitotoa o alii sili.

verses.en: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
verses.sm: O aʻu lava, ua ou fai atu i oʻu tagata ua tofia, ua ou valaau lava i oʻu tagata totoa, ia oo ai loʻu ita, o oʻu tagata mitamita ma le faamaualuluga.

verses.en: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
verses.sm: O le taalili o le vao tagata i mauga, peiseai o se nuu e toatele lava, o le taalili o le faanunununu o malo o nuu ese ua faapotopoto mai; O le ALII o “au o loo aofai e ia o “au e tau ai le taua.

verses.en: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.sm: § Ua latou o mai i le nuu mamao, mai le tuluiga o le lagi, o le ALII ma auupega o lona toasa, ina ia faaumatia le nuu uma lava.

verses.en: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
verses.sm: Ina uio ia, auā ua latalata le aso o le ALII, e 00 mai pei o se malaia mai Le e ona le malosi uma lava.

verses.en: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:
verses.sm: O le mea lea e vaivai ai lima uma, e faavaivai ai foi loto o tagata uma;

verses.en: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
verses.sm: ona latou atuatuvale ai lea; e maua i latou i le puapuaga ma le faatiga; latou te oono faapei o le fafine a fanau; O le malaia o Papelonia O le avega a Papelonia na vaaia e Isaia le atalii o latou te fevaaiai le tasi i le tasi ma le fememeai; o latou mata o mata au tunu ia.

verses.en: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
verses.sm: Faauta, o loo sau le aso o le ALII, e ogoogo i le toatamai ma le toasa tele; e fai ai le nuu ma faatafunaga; na te faaumatia foi tagata agasala o i ai.

verses.en: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
verses.sm: Auā o fetu o le lagi ma ona faaputuputugafetu, e le fepulafi mai i latou; e faapouliuligia le la i lona alu ae, o le masina foi e le susulu mai lona malamalama.

verses.en: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.sm: Ou te faasalaina le lalolagi ona o a latou amio leaga, O tagata ulavavale foi ona O a latou agasala; ou te faaumatia foi le faasausili o e faamaualuluga, ou te lafotuina i lalo le faasiasia O e faasaua.

verses.en: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
verses.sm: Ou te faatoaitiitia tagata e sili i le auro lelei, o tagata lava e sili ona toaitiiti i le auro o Ofeira.

verses.en: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te faagateteina ai le lagi, e lulueseina foi le lalolagi i le mea o i ai, i le toatamai o le ALII o ‘au, ma le aso o lona toasa tele.

verses.en: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
verses.sm: E pei o le sevi ua tulia, e pei o le lafu mamoe foi e leai se na te faapotopotoina, latou te taitasi ma liliu atu i lona lava nuu, latou te taitasi foi ma sola i lona lava laueleele.

verses.en: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
verses.sm: O i latou uma e maua e tutuʻi ia te i latou, atoa ma i latou uma e puea, e oti i latou i le pelu.

verses.en: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
verses.sm: E palasi a latou tama meamea i o latou luma; e vetea o latou fale, e fetosoina foi a latou ava.

verses.en: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
verses.sm: Faauta, ou te faaoso atu Metai e tau ma i latou, latou te le manatu i ario, e le mananao foi i latou i auro.

verses.en: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
verses.sm: O a latou aufana e nutimomomoina ai taulelea, latou te le alolofa IOOI foi i fanau, latou te le faasaoina tama.

verses.en: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.sm: O Papelonia foi, o le ua sili ona matagofie i malo, o le aai matagofie e mitamita ai Kaletaia, e avea lava lea e pei o le faaumatia o Sotoma ma Komoro e le Atua.

verses.en: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
verses.sm: E le toe aina e faavavau, e le mau ai lava se tasi i lea tupulaga ma lea tupulaga; e le to lauapi ai foi le Arapi, o leoleo mamoe foi latou te le ave ai o latou lafu e taooto ai.

verses.en: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
verses.sm: A e tavoto ai manu feai o le vao, e tutumu foi o latou fale i lulu, e mau ai foi iaena, e taaalo ai foi ‘oti o le vao.

verses.en: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
verses.sm: E tagi foi aie i o latou maota, atoa ma luko i maota sa fiafia ai. E lata mai ona po, e le faalevalevaina foi ona aso. O le malaia o Papelonia ma Asuria, ma le manuia o
